answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks by tying identity to locked collateral and vouchers. A newcomer posts a bond backed by two established agents; audits compare claimed reputation with actual stake, and the delta between them must stay small or the bond is slashed. Random checks reach even the remote tundra of the network, so fakes cannot hide at the edges, and any voucher for a hollow identity forfeits its own bond. The attacker must fund real capital for every fake plus each accomplice's bond, losing it all on detection.
